newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannon-Flax to up capital by private issue.
newsitem.headline: Pannon-Flax to up capital by private issue.

text.p: Hungarian textile industrial company Pannon-Flax Rt said on Thursday it will raise its share capital in early October via the private issue of new shares with the size of the issue around the present capital.
"The size will be in the range of the current capital, if not higher," board member Erno Varadi told a news conference.
Pannon-Flax's share capital is 627.6 million forints.
The company wants to use revenues from the increase to buy new machinery to boost sales volumes and to reduce costs and did not exclude a company acquisition either.
The lead manager of the transaction will be chosen from three competitors on Friday, and the company will call a shareholders meeting to seek approval for the increase.
Another board member, Gabor Moricz, said they were aiming for an issue price of bourse price minus single digit discount.

Pannon-Flax released its first half earnings report on Thursday and reported its consolidated pre-tax profits rising to 93.6 million forints from 42.5 million in the same period of 1996. Its net sales were up to 1.397 billion forints from 1.314 billion.
On Thursday Pannon-Flax shares finished at 1,600 forints, down 110.
